status: desk-research hypotheses; no buyer or economic validation
scope: 24 overlapping segments and buying functions; not an exhaustive taxonomy or additive market size
tie_break: Higher access, then segment name; equal scores are not substantively different.

segments.proposed_workflow: Sales → delivery → finance: signed scope to project readiness and invoice evidence.
segments.cold_channel: HubSpot solutions directory; public consultancy websites. Qualify technical implementation firms, excluding marketing-only agencies.
segments.main_risk: Technical buyers can build internally; fragmented project rules can turn delivery into consulting.

segments.proposed_workflow: Client services → accounting delivery → reviewer/finance: document collection, close readiness, reviewed deliverables and billing.
segments.cold_channel: Xero advisor directory; publicly advertised practice operations roles.
segments.main_risk: Karbon already combines workflow and AI. Client data boundaries, API access and professional review add work.

segments.proposed_workflow: Account management → assessment delivery → reviewer: evidence requests, remediation handoffs and accepted report preparation.
segments.cold_channel: Vanta service-provider ecosystem and public consultancy sites. Listing does not confer partnership or customer access.
segments.main_risk: Vanta and adjacent platforms already automate evidence. Need a demonstrated gap across systems, not another compliance chatbot.

segments.segment: Managed IT service providers: internal operations
segments.proposed_workflow: Sales → service desk → finance: contract handoff, onboarding readiness, service evidence and billing reconciliation.
segments.cold_channel: Public MSP websites and vendor communities; qualify independently. No verified account list assembled.
segments.main_risk: Rewst is a strong specialist. Restrict first scope to MSP internal operations; managing many customer environments needs additional isolation and fleet capabilities.

segments.segment: E-commerce brands with internal operations teams
segments.proposed_workflow: Customer support → warehouse → finance: returns exceptions and reconciled refund evidence.
segments.cold_channel: Public brand websites, Shopify ecosystem and operations communities; no marketplace acceptance assumed.
segments.main_risk: Easy-to-reach does not mean profitable: Shopify Flow and abundant apps constrain pricing, while high-volume support can remain expensive.

segments.proposed_workflow: Account management → creative delivery → finance: scope changes, completion acceptance and billing handoffs.
segments.cold_channel: HubSpot public directory and agency websites; exclude technical consultancies counted separately.
segments.main_risk: Productive and agency tools cover the core. Differentiation and budgets may be weak despite easy prospect discovery.

segments.proposed_workflow: Resident/client services → maintenance/vendor management → finance: non-emergency job completion evidence and invoice readiness.
segments.cold_channel: Propertymark public expert directory; qualify multi-function firms rather than individual agents or offices.
segments.main_risk: AppFolio is expanding agents across operations. Local systems, thin customer margins and exceptional repairs can create support load.

segments.proposed_workflow: Recruitment operations → onboarding/payroll → finance: placement paperwork to payroll and invoice readiness.
segments.cold_channel: Agency websites and REC directory candidate; directory entry retrieval was blocked in this research.
segments.main_risk: Bullhorn covers the lifecycle; payroll and personal data complicate integration. Exclude automated candidate selection from the first application.

segments.proposed_workflow: Customer service → shipment operations → finance: document gaps, exception resolution and billing evidence.
segments.cold_channel: Forwarder websites and trade directories; BIFA directory request returned 403, so membership entries were not verified.
segments.main_risk: CargoWise already automates these processes. Heterogeneous systems, integrations and operational urgency may consume the apparent high value.

segments.proposed_workflow: Account servicing → placement operations → finance: renewal evidence completeness and handoff preparation.
segments.cold_channel: Public broker websites and specialist directories; directory coverage and conversion untested.
segments.main_risk: Applied Epic owns much of the workflow. Sensitive records and system access need domain-specific assurance; exclude underwriting and advice.

segments.proposed_workflow: Sales → warehouse/procurement → finance: order exceptions, missing delivery evidence and invoice reconciliation.
segments.cold_channel: Supplier and manufacturer dealer directories, trade shows and company websites; channel effectiveness untested.
segments.main_risk: ERP suites already own order-to-cash. Legacy access and custom inventory rules can make each deployment different.

segments.proposed_workflow: Site operations → commercial/project controls → finance: subcontractor completion evidence and invoice review.
segments.cold_channel: Contractor websites and public supplier/project lists; direct acquisition channel not validated.
segments.main_risk: Procore already joins field and finance. Project-specific processes, subcontractor access and uneven source data reduce reuse.

segments.proposed_workflow: Dispatch → field completion review → finance: service evidence, missing parts/documents and billing handoff.
segments.cold_channel: Contractor and equipment-service company websites; channel and buyer qualification untested.
segments.main_risk: Potentially valuable project-to-cash work, but field data and installed systems vary. Current evidence is adjacent construction software, not a verified segment-specific gap.

segments.proposed_workflow: Business intake → risk reviewer → matter operations/finance: intake evidence, authorized matter setup and billing readiness.
segments.cold_channel: Public firm websites and professional directories; identifiable firms do not imply access to decision makers.
segments.main_risk: Intapp already covers intake and conflicts. Confidentiality, matter permissions and specialist exceptions increase delivery effort. No autonomous legal opinions.

segments.proposed_workflow: Property operations → procurement → finance: supplier exceptions and reconciled invoice evidence.
segments.cold_channel: Group websites and hospitality-system ecosystems; qualify multi-site organizations with central operations.
segments.main_risk: Property systems and continuous operations increase integration/support effort; willingness to pay for an additional platform is untested.

segments.proposed_workflow: Sales → legal → finance: agreed contract obligations to authorized operational handoffs.
segments.cold_channel: Public legal-operations communities, events and company roles; buyer discovery is more indirect than firm directories.
segments.main_risk: Ironclad and enterprise suites already serve the buyer; proving integration value and passing procurement can be costly.

segments.proposed_workflow: Program officers → due diligence/review → finance: grant evidence, disbursement readiness and reporting follow-up.
segments.cold_channel: Published grant portfolios, foundation websites and sector communities; applicants are not the buyer.
segments.main_risk: Fluxx already covers the grant lifecycle. Ability to award large grants does not establish an internal software budget.

segments.proposed_workflow: Procurement → supplier-quality review → finance: supplier evidence, purchase exceptions and accepted invoice readiness.
segments.cold_channel: Manufacturer websites and supplier ecosystems; no qualified procurement-owner list verified.
segments.main_risk: ERP integration and company-specific approval rules are substantial. Restrict scope to office processes, not machinery or production control.

segments.proposed_workflow: Scheduling/referrals → administration → finance: document and claim readiness with human review.
segments.cold_channel: Provider group websites; clinical-system access is a separate commercial and technical gate.
segments.main_risk: Existing interfaces do not imply accessible test data or installation rights. Health records and payer-specific exceptions add substantial assurance and support effort.

sources.title: Epic CDS and prior-authorization integration guidance

segments.proposed_workflow: Research office → departmental administrators → finance: award setup, missing evidence and reporting readiness.
segments.cold_channel: University staff pages, research-administration events and public procurement.
segments.main_risk: Cayuse covers award workflows. Multiple institutional stakeholders and fragmented systems can make a first sale and deployment slow.

segments.proposed_workflow: Service operations → review team → finance: supplier or service-case evidence and authorized handoff.
segments.cold_channel: Find a Tender provides a public discovery channel; bidding eligibility and suitable notices must be checked per opportunity.
segments.main_risk: A visible procurement channel is not easy market entry. Formal buying and support requirements may exceed the current product and vendor capacity.

segments.buyer: COO / CIO with program and finance sponsor
segments.proposed_workflow: Programs → grants/compliance → finance: field evidence to reviewed donor-reporting package and follow-up actions.
segments.cold_channel: NetHope public membership and events, organization websites and published tenders. No personal relationship assumed.
segments.main_risk: Budget ownership, donor conditions and heterogeneous country operations need validation. Private deployment is not yet private model inference; existing nonprofit software offers also compete.

segments.segment: Banks, lenders and regulated financial operations
segments.proposed_workflow: Relationship operations → compliance reviewer → account operations: onboarding evidence and handoff tracking.
segments.cold_channel: Public company roles, vendor programs and procurement; no readily accessible pilot channel verified.
segments.main_risk: ServiceNow and established platforms already orchestrate onboarding. Vendor assurance and operational support could overwhelm early revenue. Exclude credit or investment decisions.

segments.proposed_workflow: Study operations → document/quality review → finance: evidence completeness and site-payment readiness.
segments.cold_channel: Public sponsor/CRO websites and industry events; no qualified buyer-access channel verified.
segments.main_risk: Veeva covers clinical operations. Domain validation, confidential trial data and specialist support are major unknown costs. Exclude clinical decisions.
